## Sample configuration (upstream)

```
# $HOME/.config/katana/form-config.yaml
email: "rand_email()"
phone: "rand_phone()"
placeholder: "rand_first_name()"
password: 'rand_base(16, "")'
color: "#e66465"
```

$ cat cookie.txt

X-API-KEY: XXXXX
TOKEN=XX
